== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Izyrians are a people native to the continent of [[Izyria]], characterized by their pale skin and light hair. Historically, they were organized into tribes that inhabited high mountain ranges, where they survived by hunting [[Kameira]]. While much of their society was once integrated into the [[Aurelian Empire]], recent years have seen a resurgence of ancient traditions and a movement toward reclaiming independence. This shift includes the return of [[blood]]-sport in their arenas and a growing desire for self-governance, with some regions seeking to rule themselves rather than follow [[Imperial]] [[Authority|authority]]. [[Izyrian]] culture is deeply tied to the tradition of combat and the arena. The [[Champion’s Guild]], which has headquarters in the city of [[Axciss]], plays a significant role in their society. Gladiators and duelists are common, and even the Emperor has historically respected the rules of the [[ring]]. The [[Izyrian]] people are currently experiencing significant instability due to missing leadership and internal chaos, which has led to civil unrest and political tension with [[The Empire|the Empire]].}}
